name: Dumbbell Decline Neutral-Grip Bench Press
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a decline, secure your legs under the pads, and lie back with dumbbells.
Hold both dumbbells above your chest with palms facing each other and shoulder blades set flat.
Bend your elbows near your sides to lower the dumbbells beside your lower chest.
Press both dumbbells straight up until your arms extend while keeping the handles parallel.
tips: Keep your wrists stacked directly over your elbows throughout.
Keep your shoulders pressed against the bench instead of shrugging toward your ears.
